datasets.title: Ghana - Catchment areas
datasets.description: This dataset shows Ghana catchment areas with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/ghana-catchment-areas]

lineage.description: Catchment areas were generated by identifying population clusters using gridded population data (WorldPop 2020), assigning representative points to each settlement cluster, and deriving Voronoi-based catchment polygons. Population and building attributes were then aggregated from multiple sources (META population estimates, OpenStreetMap, and Google Buildings datasets) into these catchment geometries to create a baseline spatial inventory of assets and populations.

sources.name: WorldPop
sources.description: Gridded population estimates for 2020 used to identify population clusters and generate catchment areas

sources.name: META (Facebook/Meta)
sources.description: High-resolution population estimates disaggregated by sex and age groups (2023) integrated into catchment area profiles

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.description: Building footprint data (2023) contributing to building stock inventory within catchment areas

sources.name: Google Buildings
sources.description: Machine-learning derived building detections at multiple confidence thresholds (60%, 70%, 80%) and average footprint measurements (2023)
